historical_references.reference: Devajay was a celebrated king of the Vijayanagara Empire during the late 15th and early 16th centuries. He is particularly known for his victories over the Bahamani Sultanate and the Deccan sultans, which helped establish the Empire's dominance in the region.

Devajay was also known as 'Sangamadeva' or 'Sangama Raja'. He ruled the Eastern Chalukya Empire in the 11th century and is remembered for his patronage of art, architecture, and literature. His most notable achievement was the construction of the Temple of Kailasa at Ellora, one of the UNESCO World Heritage Sites in India.
